definition: Physically protects infrastructure from inundation with barriers, sealing or waterproof ducts, other than by elevation or drainage
Raises equipment or structures above expected flood levels
Uses drainage measures to reduce flood or water exposure
Strengthens structures against high winds or storms
Protects equipment or structures against extreme temperatures
Strengthens foundations, structures, ducts or other physical components against hazards other than wind
Protects equipment from rain, dust, humidity or severe weather with enclosures or materials, other than against flood water
